title: PELAGIC — GPU Observatory
backend: WebGPU primary; automatic WebGL2 fallback; ?webgl forces fallback
techniques: TSL analytic ocean displacement with analytic normals and emissive interference bands
WebGPU compute orbital particle field; TSL vertex equivalent on WebGL2
Procedural plasma and Fresnel emission with HDR bloom
Shadow mapping, metallic gyroscopic rings, animated instanced satellites, raycast selection
Bounded quadratic complexity ramp and adaptive render resolution
limitations: Wall-frame timing only; no GPU timestamps
Analytic particle field, not fluid physics
Opaque water approximation; no ray tracing or reflection pass
Only directional light casts shadows; point lights provide unshadowed colored illumination
Counts include shadow and post passes
Quick tunnel requires running process and changes URL on restart
